label: 暗黑祭祠烛光恍惚：后仰伸颈、红烛环绕、傩面前景

subject.description: an adult East Asian woman with long messy black hair, wet loose strands framing her face, soft smoky eye makeup, flushed skin, and glossy lips,
subject.pose: as she leans slightly forward while tilting her head far back, chin raised, neck elongated, eyes looking upward, lips softly parted
subject.wardrobe: a deep red and black embroidered camisole dress with ornate traditional patterns and thin straps, delicate red metallic hair ornaments trailing behind her hair

sections.heading: Setting
sections.body: she is surrounded by burning red candles, dark carved wood, hanging crimson fabric, antique ritual objects, and traditional masks.

camera.position: at close range, a tight vertical composition
camera.perspective: shallow depth of field, dramatic chiaroscuro
camera.framing: her face and upper body dominating the frame

foreground.elements: A blurred painted ritual mask and a large glowing candle

light.key: Warm candlelight illuminates her face and shoulders from the side
light.fill: a strong orange rim light outlines her hair, with deep black shadows behind and red and gold reflections throughout the scene

background: the dark ancient ritual shrine interior sinking into deep black shadows
palette_text: deep red, crimson, black, warm gold
atmosphere: a sensual, mysterious Chinese ritual fantasy mood
